# .github/issues — import-ready issue manifest (Owner: Member D)

`manifest.json` holds one GitHub Issue per WBS task (38), plus the labels and the 7 milestones.
It is generated by `node scripts/github/generate.mjs` from `docs/planning/wbs_data.json`.

Create everything on GitHub (idempotent, no duplicates):

```bash
gh auth login
node scripts/github/setup_github.mjs --dry-run      # preview
node scripts/github/setup_github.mjs                # create repo (private), push, labels, milestones, issues, protection
```

Placeholders like `{{#2.1.1}}` in bodies are replaced with real issue numbers (`#5`) after creation.
The mapping is saved to `issue_numbers.json`.

Without `gh`: each entry has `title`, `labels`, `milestone` and a Markdown `body` that can be pasted into
GitHub's "New issue" form.
